title: Replication needs a denominator
hook: Two stated cases: explore the descriptive success share without a universal-effect claim.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the descriptive success share without a universal-effect claim affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Share, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the descriptive success share without a universal-effect claim in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
